cells.n: Subject of the verb; κύριος here is nominative and refers to YHWH as the agent who stirred up the spirit
aorist indicative context requires 'became' per lexicon rule
Orthodox lexicon preferred form for γίνομαι aorist; context: rebellions and exiles came to pass/occurred in it
Present passive indicative γίνεται contextually 'is being done/carried out' rather than aorist 'became'

cells.en: you may settle as an inheritance
